name: Sour Tsunami Jeeter Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: This lime-packed, indica-dominant profile comes in waves of sweet lime and lightly baked spice notes on the exhale. Its aroma gives off a subtle earthiness and is balanced with a sweet citrus scent. With summer in full swing, the relaxing effects of our Sour Tsunami make it the perfect go-to for a day on the beach.
